description: List the vocabulary the other fdic_ tools accept and return: every financial metric name with its FDIC field, unit, and basis (single quarter, year-to-date, or point in time), bank charter classes, failure resolution methods, insurance funds, the asset bands fdic_compare_peers uses, and the years each dataset covers. Served from built-in tables; no request to FDIC.

topic.description: Which table to list: metrics (names, FDIC fields, units, basis, default set), bank_classes, failure_methods, insurance_funds, peer_asset_bands, or coverage (years and cadence of each dataset).

name: fdic_list_reference

entries.description: Every entry of the topic, in table order.

items.description: One vocabulary entry; fields beyond code and label depend on the topic.

basis.description: point_in_time = balance at quarter end; quarter = that quarter alone; quarter_annualized = ratio from the quarter, annualized; year_to_date = accumulated since January 1; ytd_annualized = ratio from the year-to-date flow, annualized (metrics).

code.description: The value to pass or read back: metric name, class code, method code, fund, band, or dataset.

field.description: FDIC Call Report field code the metric maps to, e.g. ROAQ (metrics).

in_default_set.description: True when the metric is returned when a tool is called without metrics.

lag.description: Typical delay before a period appears (coverage).

max_assets.description: Exclusive upper bound of the band, total assets in thousands of US dollars.

min_assets.description: Inclusive lower bound of the band, total assets in thousands of US dollars.

note.description: Caveat on the metric, such as zero meaning not reported.

resolution.description: The one resolution type this method code occurs on; absent when it occurs on both (failure_methods).

unit.description: Unit of the metric: usd_thousands, percent (1.71 = 1.71%), or count (metrics).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: List FDIC reference vocabulary
